title: Young dishwasher, failed drain pump
pm_description: Dishwasher leaves standing water in the bottom after every cycle.

troubleshooting.step: Remove and rinse the filter in the base
Run a short rinse programme and listen at the end
troubleshooting.result: No pumping sound at all, water stays

resident_symptoms: The water just stays in the bottom, about two inches
I can't hear the pump at the end like I used to

title: Washer-dryer, drain pump hums then stops
pm_description: Washer-dryer not draining at end of cycle. Resident says it has been getting worse over two weeks.

troubleshooting.step: Clean the drain filter behind the bottom-left flap
troubleshooting.result: Filter was clean, no debris. Made no difference.

troubleshooting.step: Check the drain hose behind the machine is not kinked (visible part only)

resident_symptoms: There's a low humming noise at the point where it should pump out, then nothing happens
Water just sits in the drum at the end of the cycle
No leak anywhere

title: Ten-year-old oven, failed fan element
pm_description: Fan oven not heating. Grill and hob work fine.

troubleshooting.step: Check the clock is set and the oven is not in timer/lock mode
Try the conventional (top and bottom) setting

resident_symptoms: The fan goes round but it stays cold on the fan setting
Top and bottom heat works, and the grill works

must_mention: The appliance is past Iterum's 7-year age line

title: Nine-year-old fridge-freezer, compressor failure
pm_description: Fridge-freezer not cooling in either compartment.

troubleshooting.step: Check the temperature dial/setting has not been turned down
troubleshooting.result: Set to the normal middle setting

troubleshooting.step: Check the vents inside are not blocked by food

resident_symptoms: Both the fridge and freezer are warm, the ice cream has melted
The back of it clicks every few minutes and then goes quiet
The back isn't warm like it normally is

title: Ceramic hob, reported crack, no photo
pm_description: Resident reports a crack across the ceramic hob top.
resident_symptoms: There's a crack running across the glass from the front left ring
I've stopped using it
known_gaps: No photo - the resident did not send one when asked

must_mention: No photo of the crack has been seen

title: Dishwasher, control board error code
pm_description: Dishwasher showing error code and won't start a programme.

troubleshooting.step: Switch off at the wall for five minutes and switch back on
Check the door closes fully and clicks

resident_symptoms: It shows E09 as soon as I press start
None of the programmes will run

title: Young integrated fridge-freezer, repair just over the 70% line
pm_description: Integrated fridge-freezer: fridge compartment warm, freezer fine.

troubleshooting.step: Check the fridge temperature setting
Check the door seal for gaps with a sheet of paper
troubleshooting.result: Seal grips the paper all the way round

resident_symptoms: The fridge part is about 12 degrees on my thermometer
The freezer is still frozen solid

must_mention: The repair cost is close to or above the roughly 70% repair-to-replacement line

title: Nine-year-old oven, repeat repairs
pm_description: Oven door won't stay shut again.

troubleshooting.step: Check nothing is caught in the door and the shelves are pushed fully in

resident_symptoms: The door drops open on its own again
It was fixed a few months ago and now it's doing the same thing

must_mention: Two repairs within the last twelve months

title: Washer-dryer just under the 7-year line, thermostat
pm_description: Washer-dryer washes fine but won't dry.

troubleshooting.step: Clean the lint filter and condenser access flap if fitted
Run a short drying programme on a small load
troubleshooting.result: Drum turns but clothes come out cold and wet

resident_symptoms: Washing is fine but drying does nothing, it's cold inside
The drum still turns when it's meant to be drying

must_mention: The appliance's age (close to the 7-year line) as an argument against repair

title: Washer-dryer with contradictory symptoms
pm_description: Washer-dryer not draining.

troubleshooting.step: Clean the drain filter
troubleshooting.result: Resident says they did it but isn't sure they opened it properly

resident_symptoms: It makes a humming noise when it should be emptying
Actually it's completely silent at the end, I don't hear anything
Water stays in the drum
known_gaps: Unclear whether the filter was fully opened

must_mention: The conflicting accounts of humming versus silence

title: Ceramic hob just out of warranty, reported crack, no photo
pm_description: Resident reports the hob glass has cracked after a pan was dropped.
resident_symptoms: I dropped a pan on it and now there's a crack through the glass
The ring nearest the crack still comes on
known_gaps: No photo - the resident did not send one when asked

must_not: Uses the hob's young age as an argument for repair

title: Induction hob zone failure, part out of stock
pm_description: One zone on the induction hob not working, others fine.

troubleshooting.step: Try a pan that a magnet sticks to on that zone
Check the child lock is off
troubleshooting.result: Lock is off, other zones work

resident_symptoms: The back right ring doesn't do anything, the other three are fine
It doesn't show an error, just nothing happens
known_gaps: Generator module out of stock - 9 day lead time from supplier

title: Oven with no troubleshooting evidence
pm_description: Oven not working.
known_gaps: Resident did not respond to troubleshooting messages

title: Washer-dryer past the age line, cheap door seal
pm_description: Washer-dryer leaking from the front during washes.

troubleshooting.step: Wipe the door seal and check for trapped items or tears
troubleshooting.result: There's a split in the rubber at the bottom of the seal

resident_symptoms: Water comes out the front at the bottom of the door
There's a split in the rubber bit at the bottom

must_mention: The appliance's age (past the 7-year line) as an argument against repair
